title: Update 27.1 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 Release Wave 2
summary: Update 27.1 for Business Central 2025 release wave 2 introduces new Copilot and AI agent capabilities for payables and sales automation, e-document processing enhancements, financial management features, and sustainability reporting, with general availability for most features and optional features becoming mandatory in the next release wave.
features: Payables Agent for automating payables processes
MCP server integration for AI agents
